crossRefs.note: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and…
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and…
Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be…
Therefore Yahweh’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a…
When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward, and fell to the ground.

translations.web: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
translations.bsb: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
translations.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
translations.asv: Let them be put to shame and confounded That seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.
